binding_details_popup.title: Binding Details
binding_details_popup.press_type_label_description: Choose between a quick tap (Short) or holding the key (Long).
binding_details_popup.behavior_label_description: Toggle stays active after press. Hold requires keeping the key down.
binding_details_popup.consume_label_description: Determines whether the game will receive this keystroke. 'Always' blocks game input, 'Interface focus enabled' blocks only when SPF windows are open, 'Plugin controlled' blocks by plugin, 'Never' does not block.
binding_details_popup.threshold_label_description: How long (in milliseconds) the key must be held to count as a Long Press.
binding_details_popup.mode_label_description: Select how the axis should be processed. Analog provides smooth values, Digital emulates a button press.
binding_details_popup.deadzone_label_description: The area around the center of the axis where movement is ignored to prevent drifting.
binding_details_popup.saturation_label_description: The point beyond which further axis movement is considered 100% input.
binding_details_popup.sensitivity_label_description: Multiplies the input signal. Useful for fine-tuning response speed.
binding_details_popup.curve_label_description: Mathematical model for signal processing (e.g., Exponential for finer control around the center).
binding_details_popup.smoothing_label_description: Filters out sudden spikes or noise in the signal for a smoother feel.
binding_details_popup.side_label_description: Select which part of the physical axis to use for this action.
binding_details_popup.range_min_label_description: Minimum value sent to the game (usually 0.0).
binding_details_popup.range_max_label_description: Maximum value sent to the game (usually 1.0).
binding_details_popup.accumulator_mode_label_description: When enabled, the axis acts like a virtual knob. Moving the stick controls the speed at which the value increases or decreases, and the value stays where it is when the stick is released.
binding_details_popup.invert_label_description: Reverses the axis direction (Positive becomes Negative and vice-versa).

welcome_window.intro_title: Hello! Thank you for choosing our framework.
welcome_window.intro_text: We created **SPF Framework** to make your game in **ATS** and **ETS2** even more interesting, and plugin management as simple as possible.

section1.title: How to open the framework menu?
section1.text: Just press the <#FFFFFF>{} **DELETE**</> key on your keyboard. This is your main control panel.

section2.title: Installing spf-compatible plugins
section2.text: Simply place the plugin folder with the DLL in ` <#FFFFFF>{}</> ` Then activate them in the <#FFFFFF>**Plugin Manager**</> section.

section3.title: Settings
section3.text: All framework parameters and installed plugins, as well as keybind management, are conveniently collected in the <#FFFFFF>**Settings**</> tab.

section4.title: For Developers
section4.text: If you are a developer — check out our <#00b3ff>{} [GitHub]({})</>, where you will find documentation and live examples of API usage for writing your own plugin.

section5.title: Stay with us
section5.text: You can find our contacts and community links in the <#FFFFFF>**About Us**</> section.

welcome_window.footer: *Developed with <#ff0000>{}</> by the **Track & Truck Devs** team. Support us on <#00b3ff>{} [Patreon]({})</> to help the project grow!*

manual_popup.title: FAQ
manual_popup.q1_question: How to install and activate a plugin?
manual_popup.q1_answer:
Copy your SPF-compatible plugin into the directory ```{}``` Make sure the plugin's `.dll` is inside a directory that matches its name, for example `...\MyPlugin\MyPlugin.dll`
The framework will automatically find this plugin and load it. You just need to enable it in the `Plugin Manager` tab.
manual_popup.q2_question: How to create your own plugin?
manual_popup.q2_answer: To develop a plugin, you need to download the header file package `SPF_-_API.h` from the "Releases" section on our [GitHub]({}) page and include it in your project.
manual_popup.q3_question: How to add a new translation?
manual_popup.q3_answer:
To translate the `framework`, find the files in ```{}``` * copy an existing translation, for example `en.json`
 * rename it to your translation language, for example `de.json`
 * translate the strings.

The translation files for a `plugin` are located in its own localization folder, for example: ```{}```
manual_popup.q4_question: What if I need new functionality?
manual_popup.q4_answer:
If you are a developer, you can implement the required functionality yourself using our `SPF_-_API.h`.
 Otherwise, you can create a suggestion on [GitHub]({}) or on our [Patreon]({}) page.
manual_popup.q5_answer: Framework settings are located in ```{}``` Plugin settings are in their own configuration folders, for example: ```{}``` **It is recommended to change settings only through the in-game interface.**
manual_popup.q6_question: The framework or a plugin is crashing the game. What to do?
manual_popup.q6_answer:
* Check the log files in the `\spfAssets\logs` folder.
 * Try disabling plugins one by one to find the source of the problem.
 * If the problem is with the framework, please create an `issue` on our [GitHub]({}), describing the problem in detail and attaching the log file.

shutdown_popup.title: Shutdown Confirmation
shutdown_popup.content:
Are you sure you want to shut down the framework?

 **This will unload all plugins and deactivate the framework until the next game restart.**

 If you need to enable plugins without restarting the game, use the game console and enter the command ```sdk reload```
